closed: ∀ (a b c x y z : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z)(hab : a + b > c) (hbc : b + c > a) (hca : a + c > b), a/x+b/y+c/z > a/(y+z)+b/(x+z)+c/(x+y)
informal: for $a,b,c$ are three sides of triangle $ABC$ , and $x,y,z$ > $0$ , prove $a/x+b/y+c/z > a/(y+z)+b/(x+z)+c/(x+y)$ .
